description: Save a new trading strategy from existing TradeDroid strategy code to the user's library, so it can be backtested or deployed. Use this when you already have the code (hand-written or produced by generate_strategy). To create a strategy from a natural-language description instead of code, use generate_strategy. Returns the new strategy ID; validate it with what_if_backtest before deploying via deploy_bot.

code.description: TradeDroid strategy code (JavaScript) — the executable logic. Get it from generate_strategy or write it directly.

description.description: Optional plain-English summary of what the strategy does and when it trades.

market.description: "spot" for cash trading or "futures" for leveraged/perpetual contracts. Defaults to futures.

name.description: Display name for the strategy, e.g. "ETH Momentum v2".

timeframe.description: Primary candle timeframe the strategy runs on, e.g. "1h", "4h", "1d". Defaults to 1h.

name: create_strategy
